title: Registry document (SPEC.md §4)
description: The declarative registry document of the reference implementation: the wire-visible registry data — every SPEC.md §4 field except the backend-private `handler` and `dry_run` — as a versioned JSON file. The app loads it, attaches handlers by action ID and builds; the same document is the codegen input and the interchange format for conformance fixtures and non-Rust registry authors. It never crosses the wire. SPEC.md calls this serialization non-normative. The document is closed: an unknown field at any level is an error, exactly as `RegistrySchema::from_json` in crates/cleverhans-core/src/schema.rs rejects it. Kept in step with that type by crates/cleverhans-core/tests/spec_schemas.rs.

$schema.description: Optional URI reference of this JSON Schema, for editors that validate and autocomplete the document. Carried through loading and export unchanged; the framework never fetches it. Absent and null both mean no reference.

spec_version.description: Spec version the document targets (SPEC.md §13). Checked at load against the implemented version by major.minor prefix on a segment boundary, mirroring the `Init` handshake: for `0.1`, the values `0.1`, `0.1.0` and `0.1.0-draft` load while `0.10` and `0.1x` do not.

context_params.description: Declarative context-param filling: param name → context path. A path is one of `route`, `selected_record_id`, `view_type`, `params.<key>` or `extensions.<key>`, where `<key>` is a single non-empty literal map key (no nested traversal; a key may itself contain dots). Paths are validated at load. Apps that fill context params with their own resolver leave this empty. Absent means an empty map.

BlockDef.title: BlockDef
BlockDef.description: A registered UI block type with its slot schema (SPEC.md §8).

block_type.description: The closed-enum identifier the frontend routes on.

SlotSpec.title: SlotSpec
SlotSpec.description: One slot of a block type.

required.description: Whether the slot must be filled.

ActionDef.title: ActionDef
ActionDef.description: The wire-visible metadata of one action (SPEC.md §4).

description.description: Intent-matching surface presented to the model. Load-bearing: this is the tuning and evaluation surface.

params.description: Parameter schema; every param is tagged with a `source` (SPEC.md §4.1).

block_type.description: Which registered block renders proposals for this action.

authz_key.description: Opaque permission key handed to the app's authorization resolver (SPEC.md §9.3).

display.description: Human-facing presentation for launchers and palettes (SPEC.md §4.3, non-normative). The agent never reads it. Absent (or null) means the action has no palette presence.

description.description: Model-facing description (utterance params only). Absent means an empty string.

required.description: Whether the param must be present.

ParamSource.title: ParamSource
ParamSource.description: Where a parameter's value comes from (SPEC.md §4.1). `context`: filled by the framework from the app context snapshot; never writable by the model. `utterance`: emitted by the model and validated against the schema.

ValueType.title: ValueType
ValueType.description: Value type of a param or slot. Deliberately JSON-schema-lite; apps that need richer validation do it in their handler. A simple type is a string; a fixed set of strings is the object `{"string_enum": [...]}`.

oneOf.description: `string`: a UTF-8 string. `integer`: a whole number. `number`: any JSON number. `boolean`: a boolean. `json`: any JSON value; the app validates its shape in its handler.

string_enum.description: One of a fixed set of strings: the allowed values.

DisplayDef.title: DisplayDef
DisplayDef.description: How an action presents to humans in a command palette or launcher (SPEC.md §4.3) — the discoverability counterpart of the model-facing `description`. The two texts legitimately diverge and are kept separate on purpose.

description.description: One-line human description of the outcome. Absent means an empty string.

keywords.description: Extra match surface for palette search beyond the title's words.

group.description: Optional grouping key (lifecycle stage, feature area); apps define the vocabulary and ordering.

tags.description: Free-form badges the app renders (e.g. "ai" for LLM-backed actions).
